config.description: matched window, one variable: A = P1 as-is (production launch.sh verbatim: A8 flip, 60/40 layer split, mmproj CPU, ctx 262144/2 non-unified, q4_0 KV, -b 256 -ub 128 -t 4, draft-mtp default depth, jinja, load-mode none); B = same + --kv-unified --kv-unified-per-slot 262144. Both at the measured Gen3 x1 condition on the second 3060's chipset port. Scratch port 8128, scope-isolated, watchdog 5400 s, production stopped/restore-live-verified around the window (22:36:34-22:48:50, rc=0).

workload.fixture: seeded pseudo-text 16k/32k/64k (11827/23594/47241 tok) + agent pair 2x23.6K, planted-code recall; cold->warm repeats, solo decode 256 tok, two-agent concurrent prefill and decode; n=1 per cell per boot

notes: 9-cell matched matrix; window 2026-11-18T22:36:34..22:48:50 local CET (12 min 16 s); condition: PCIe Gen3 x1 on the EVGA link (bracketed by the 21:53 pre-window lspci 8 GT/s and the 22:49:02 pciewatch tick; no in-window sample; both links then downgraded to Gen1 five minutes post-window, unattributed, no kernel events). Cold prefill identical to <1%. Warm prefix reuse identical at both 12K and 47K (4 tokens recomputed, 0.45-0.58 s). Solo-decode cells are NOT a speed comparison: GPU greedy sampling is not bit-reproducible across boots (256 vs 105 tokens; 58/11 vs 103/121 two-agent), so wall times measured different work and the eval-window rates covered different token ranges. Two-agent prefill wall 101.4 vs 106.2 s (n=1, not statistically established). Fixture set: the four 16K m3-* files (3 of 9 prepared; the four m2-* 32K files staged for the multi-agent workload). No failed turns; code recall 10/10 in both boots. Verdict: unified KV performance-neutral for cold prefill and prefix reuse in this regime; P1 stays production; the P2 regression question remains with the 2026-11-15 E1/E2 prefill-wall pair pending a fixed-length decode protocol.
